keyPoints: Prithvi apni dhuri par lagbhag 24 ghante me ek chakkar lagati hai — isi ghoorne (rotation) se din aur raat hote hain.
Prithvi suraj ke chakkar lagbhag 365 din me poora karti hai; dhuri ke jhukav ke kaaran saal bhar suraj ki kirnen kabhi seedhi kabhi tedhi padti hain, jisse mausam badalte hain.
Chandrama prithvi ke chakkar lagbhag 27 din me lagata hai aur suraj ki roshni ke kon ke hisab se ghata-badhta dikhai deta hai — ise chandrama ki kalayen kehte hain.
Amavasya ko chandrama dikhai nahi deta kyunki uska andhera hissa hamari taraf hota hai, purnima ko poora gol chamakta dikhta hai.
Surya grahan tab hota hai jab chandrama suraj aur prithvi ke beech aa jaata hai aur suraj ko dhak leta hai; ise nangi aankh se kabhi nahi dekhna chahiye.
Chandra grahan tab hota hai jab prithvi suraj aur chandrama ke beech aakar chandrama par apni chhaya dalti hai, jisse wo laal-bhoora dikhta hai.
Aam galti: chandrama ki kalaon ko prithvi ki chhaya samajhna; kalayen suraj ki roshni ke badalte kon se banti hain, jabki grahan chhaya padne ki alag ghatna hai.

title: Prithvi, Chandrama aur Surya
